title: HashiCorp
description: HashiCorp's Helios Design System and published design-system-tokens define corporate brand black (#000000), white (#ffffff), strong foreground (#0c0c0e), action blues (#1060ff, #0c56e9, #0046d1), product brand colours for Terraform (#7b42bc / #a067da), Vault (#ffcf25), Consul (#e03875), Boundary (#f24c53), Nomad (#06d092), Packer (#02a8ef), Vagrant (#1868f2), and Waypoint (#14c6cb), plus neutral palette greys.
